build_cait_model: build a cait_models vision transformer with custom embed_dim depth and num_heads parameters
create_cait_XXS24: create a pretrained cait_XXS24 model with 192 embed dim and 24 depth for 384px images
create_cait_M48: create a pretrained cait_M48 model with 768 embed dim and 48 depth for 448px images
review_Class_Attention: review the Class_Attention module that computes attention from only the class token to all tokens
review_Attention_talking_head: review the Attention_talking_head module that adds talking heads projections to multi-head self-attention
